worlds.error.nospace: Nothing was changed: Not enough free disk space: this needs {need}, including {reserve} kept free for the game, but only {free} is free. Free some space and try again.
worlds.error.operation_running: An operation is running on this world. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
worlds.error.restore_name_taken: Another world now has this world's name. Rename that world, then restore this snapshot.

worlds.error.save_name: A save's name must end in .zip, must not start with a dot, and must not contain a slash.
worlds.error.save_not_found: This world has no save with that name.

worlds.error.unreadable: This world's world.json cannot be read, so Foreman will not delete it.
worlds.error.unsupported_file: This world holds a file Foreman cannot snapshot: {path} is a symlink or special file, which a snapshot cannot keep. Remove it or replace it with a copy, then try again.
worlds.error.world_changed: This world was changed or deleted while your upload was running. Nothing was saved; upload it again.
worlds.error.wrong_name: The name typed does not match the world's name.

worlds.import.folder.many_hint: Tick one folder to choose its name and version below. With several ticked, each becomes a world named after its folder, with its save's version and Space Age setting.
worlds.import.folder.nothing: There is nothing to import: no folder here can be imported, for the reasons given below. Put the save files ({zip}) in a folder, then reload this page.
worlds.import.intro: Importing copies files into a new world. The original files are never moved or changed.

worlds.generate.title: Generate a world
worlds.generate.intro: Make a new world that has no save yet. Its map is made when the world first starts.
worlds.generate.space_age.hint: Space Age only applies to Factorio 2.0 and later. Changing it changes which planets the map has.
worlds.generate.download.hint: The world cannot start until its game image ({image} at its version) is on this host. The download starts after the world is made, from Docker Hub.
worlds.generate.reset_note: The game version or Space Age changed, so the map options below were set back to that version's defaults. Check them, then continue.
worlds.generate.preset.label: Preset
worlds.generate.exchange.label: Map exchange string
worlds.generate.exchange.hint: Export it from Factorio's map generator and paste it here. It starts with >>> and ends with <<<.
worlds.generate.preview.heading: Map preview
worlds.generate.preview.made: Drawn from the current settings, which are not saved yet, with seed {seed}. It redraws as you change them. “Generate world” makes exactly this map.
worlds.generate.preview.kept: These pictures are kept for 15 minutes.
worlds.generate.preview.wait: Making the map preview. This takes a few seconds for each planet.
worlds.generate.preview.no_image: Foreman cannot make a preview because the game image for Factorio {version} is not downloaded here. Generate the world with the download ticked, or choose a version that is already downloaded.
worlds.generate.preview.busy: Another map preview is being made. Wait a few seconds, then choose “Preview map” again.
worlds.generate.preview.failed: The game could not make the map preview. You can still generate the world. If it keeps failing, check Foreman's log.
worlds.generate.preview.request_failed: The map preview request failed. Check that Foreman is reachable and that you are still signed in, then choose “Preview map” again. You can still generate the world.
worlds.generate.error.version_required: Choose a game version or type one. No world is active to take it from.
worlds.generate.error.preset: Choose one of the presets in the list.
worlds.generate.error.seed_settings: The seed in the map settings is not a whole number from 0 to 4294967295. Change it, or clear it for a random seed.
worlds.generate.error.settings: The map settings could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_empty: Paste a map exchange string, or choose another way to make the map.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_too_long: This text is too long to be a map exchange string. Paste only the string, from >>> to <<<.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_unreadabl: Foreman could not read this as a map exchange string. Export it again from Factorio and paste the whole string.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_unsupport: This string was made by Factorio {version}, which Foreman cannot read. Foreman reads strings from Factorio 1.1, 2.0 and 2.1.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_other_lin: This string was made by Factorio {version}, but this world uses {game}. A string works only with a game version of the same line (1.1, 2.0 or 2.1). Choose a matching version above, or paste another string.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_newer: This string was made by Factorio {version}, which is newer than this world's game version {game}. Choose version {version} or later above, or paste an older string.
worlds.world.generated: Generated {name}. Its map is made when it first starts.
worlds.clone.title: Clone {name}
worlds.clone.heading: New world from this one
worlds.clone.copies.settings: Its server settings and map settings.
worlds.clone.name.label: Name of the clone
worlds.clone.running: This world is running. The clone copies its newest save on disk, which may be a few minutes behind what players see.
worlds.clone.map.fresh_hint: A new map with a random seed, made when the clone first starts.
worlds.clone.map.fresh_only: A new map with a random seed is made when the clone first starts.
worlds.clone.no_save: This world has no save to keep.
worlds.clone.save_gone: The save this world would load is missing.
worlds.clone.error.choice: Choose whether to keep the save or start a fresh map.
worlds.clone.error.no_save: This world has no save to keep. Start a fresh map instead.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_layout: This string was made by Factorio {version}, and its map settings do not fit Factorio {game}, which lays them out differently. Export a new string from Factorio {game}, or choose a game version closer to {version} above.
worlds.generate.preview.timeout: The map preview took too long and was stopped. Try again, or generate the world without it.
worlds.generate.preview.oom: The game ran out of memory making the map preview. Try a smaller map, or generate the world without a preview.
worlds.generate.error.exchange_layout_ra: This string was made by Factorio {version}, and its map settings do not fit Factorio {game}. It works with Factorio {from} up to, but not including, {until}. Choose a version in that range above, or export a new string from Factorio {game}.
worlds.generate.version.other: Use a version not in the list
worlds.generate.mode.settings_hint: Start from a preset and change any setting, as in the game's map generator.
worlds.generate.mode.exchange_hint: Use the settings of a map someone shared from the game.
worlds.generate.refilled: The settings below were filled from the preset “{preset}”. Check them, then choose Generate world again.
worlds.generate.error.untested_preset: Foreman cannot write this preset's map settings for Factorio {version}, so its settings cannot be changed there. Reset them to the preset, start from the default preset, or choose another version.
worlds.generate.preview.updating: Drawing the map preview for the current settings…
worlds.generate.large.keys: Left and right arrows show the previous and next planet, plus and minus zoom, 0 fits the picture, and Escape closes. When zoomed in, drag the picture, or tap a spot to centre it, or use the arrow keys on it to move around.
worlds.generate.preview.pin: The pin marks the centre of the map, where players start.
worlds.generate.preview.size_hint: How much of the map, around its centre, the preview shows. Big sizes show their detail in the large view.
worlds.generate.error.preview_size: Choose one of the sizes in the list.
worlds.generate.territories.label: Show demolisher territories
worlds.generate.territories.hint: Finding them takes a few seconds more.
worlds.generate.territories.too_big_hint: Shown for preview sizes up to {size} × {size} tiles. Choose a smaller preview size to show them.
worlds.generate.territories.none: This picture has no demolisher territories.
worlds.generate.territories.no_vulcanus: Only Space Age worlds have demolisher territories, on Vulcanus.
worlds.generate.territories.too_big: Demolisher territories are shown for preview sizes up to {size} × {size} tiles. Choose a smaller preview size.
worlds.generate.territories.invalid: The settings have problems, so the demolisher territories were not found. Fix the problems the map preview lists.
worlds.generate.territories.busy: Another map preview is being made, so the demolisher territories were not found. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
worlds.generate.territories.draw_busy: Other pictures with territories are being drawn right now. Wait a few seconds, then download again.
worlds.generate.territories.timeout: Finding the demolisher territories took too long and was stopped. Try again, or choose a smaller preview size.
worlds.generate.territories.oom: The game ran out of memory finding the demolisher territories. Choose a smaller preview size.
worlds.generate.territories.failed: The game could not find the demolisher territories. The map preview and Generate still work. If it keeps failing, check Foreman's log.
worlds.generate.territories.request_fail: The request for the demolisher territories failed. Check that Foreman is reachable and that you are still signed in, then try again.
